chain: packages/host/src/plugin.js apply(): createHost({ config, logger }) — no `http` overrides, so http.dshWebOrigin is undefined.
=> wrapper CSP frame-ancestors = 'self' http://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:* (contains a loopback wildcard)
entry document CSP frame-ancestors = http://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:* <resourceOrigin> (same fallback)
rootCause.note: The resource service already supports the exact origin (dshWebOrigin parameter + unit test "wrapper frame-ancestors ... exact when known"), the production composition simply never passes it.

impact: Wrapper/entry documents can be framed by any loopback origin instead of exactly the DSH page. Egress boundary itself is intact (wrapper frame-src only resourceOrigin; game connect-src exact) — this is a header-contract/hardening gap, not an egress hole.
suggestedFix: plugin.js should derive the DSH web origin (e.g. from ctx.get("webServer") host/port/protocol) and call createHost({ config, logger, http: { dshWebOrigin } }); keep the fallback only for CLI/unit contexts. No probe assertion change.
